title: SWEET PIXEL STUDIO
playable_note: On 2026-10-20 Ali said to preserve and honor before building new browser games. Do not add a playable Pixel Fall in this milestone.

archive.meta_description: an indie mobile game development studio in pakistan

studio.blurb: We are a small and scrappy clan of creative professionals coming from a broad range of experience and education who share one thing in common: Our sheer love for all things gaming.
studio.invitation: Are you also someone who believes that games are an awesome medium to create breathtaking new experieces?
studio.quote: WHEN LIFE GIVES YOU LEMONS, MAKE LEMONADE TYCOON
studio.status_line: Sweet Pixel Studio shut down in 2014. It was a great passion project that did not fan out. We had to move on to other work, and the team disbanded.
studio.story_source: Ali in gamedev on 2026-10-20. He gave the shutdown year and the three game memories. He did not give a start year or a city. Boom and Johnny Ace have no memory line. The lemonade quote stays. The nine credits stay a quiet roll call.
studio.art_caption: Original artwork from the studio sites. Johnny Ace has no surviving thumbnail in the archive.

wall.name: Abode
wall.summary: Horror adventure. The 2017 navigation called it Our Game.

wall.summary: Put your gaming skills and reflexes to an almost impossible trial of exhilarated Jumping.
wall.memory: Our attempt at a fun-filled, quick-finger game.
wall.gameplay_note: Help your beloved monsters Jump through these nifty and tricky levels and put your gaming expertise and reflexes to an almost incredible test of exhilarated Jumping.

render.wall_test_scope: Assert those five names once each, in that order, on the game wall only. Johnny Ace is a game card, not a credit.
render.credits_render: All nine credits, short name and role, in catalog order. Sayyam and Mubassir Hayat are included. Johnny Ace is not a credit. Render portrait.src for the seven About-page portraits. Sayyam and Mubassir have none.
render.thumbnails: Render wall thumbnail.src and thumbnail.alt when thumbnail is an object. Paths stay under assets/ and are copied into the build. Do not hotlink. Johnny Ace's thumbnail is null.
render.voice: The studio shut down in 2014. Render status_line, archive_heading, hero_kicker, hero_footer, and art_caption. Render wall memory when it is set, and still render summary. Boom and Johnny Ace have no memory. Do not render the hiring invitation. Credits stay a quiet roll call: short name and role only.
